title: 零ゴシック
description: A Japanese free font by Flop Design: an extra-bold gothic with cracks like broken glass. More than 8,000 glyphs. Strong for impact, collapse, and horror. OFL-1.1 allows a later promotion into the bundled binaries (today this is an index only).
when_to_use: For an emphasis caption or thumbnail title about a shocking fact, a collapse, or a horror lean
ai_usage: OFL-1.1 のため実体同梱への昇格が可能（昇格はオーナー裁定）。現状は索引のみ。グリフ形状そのもの（フォントファイル）は改変しない
